label: HigherGov
description: Read government opportunities, awards, contractors and your pursuits

operations.name: list_agencies
operations.description: Description:Federal and State and Local Agencies and hierarchies.    Update Frequency: Ad Hoc as new agencies are created or become relevant.

operations.name: list_awardees
operations.description: Description: Federal Awardees registered in SAM and DSBS.    Update Frequency: Updated Monthly.    Update Check Field: registration_last_update_date

operations.name: list_mentor_protege_relationships
operations.description: Read the published HigherGov mentor_protege_relationships endpoint.

operations.name: list_prime_sub_partnerships
operations.description: Description: Teaming partnerships between different Awardees.    Update Frequency: Updated Weekly with new subaward data.

operations.name: list_contracts
operations.description: Description: Federal prime contract awards.    Update Frequency: Daily by 2am (for two days prior)   Update Check Field: last_modified_date.

operations.name: list_documents
operations.description: Description: Returns paths for downloading the documents associated with the opportunity. The related_key is required and is found in the document_path field in the Opportunity endpoint.   Update Frequency: Real time.

operations.name: list_grants
operations.description: Description: Federal prime grant awards.    Update Frequency: Daily by 2am (for two days prior)   Update Check Field: last_modified_date.

operations.name: list_grant_programs
operations.description: Description:Government Assistance Programs (Grant Programs or CFDAs).    Update Frequency: Ad hoc as new programs are released, typically monthly.

operations.name: list_indefinite_delivery_vehicles
operations.description: Description: Federal prime IDV awards.    Update Frequency: Daily by 2am (for two days prior)   Update Check Field: last_modified_date.

operations.name: list_naics_codes
operations.description: Description: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) codes.    Update Frequency: Updated Ad Hoc when codes added or removed by the Census Bureau or the SBA changes size standards

operations.name: list_opportunities
operations.description: Description: Includes federal Contract, DIBBS, Grants, and State and Local Opportunities.    Update Frequency: Updated every 30 minutes   Update Check Field: captured_date.

operations.name: list_people
operations.description: Description: Federal and State and Local People.    Update Frequency: Updated in real time.   Update Check Field: as_of_date.

operations.name: list_product_service_codes
operations.description: Description: Product Service Codes (PSC) Codes.    Update Frequency: Updated Ad Hoc when codes added or removed

operations.name: list_pursuits
operations.description: Description: Returns the authenticated client's HigherGov pursuits tied to their account and managed in https://www.highergov.com/pursuit/. This endpoint is for a user's internal pursuit records, not for searching government opportunities. If you want to look up federal contract, grant, or other opportunities or forecasts, use the Opportunity endpoint instead.   Update Frequency: Real time.

operations.name: list_state_local_contracts
operations.description: State and Local Government contract awards.

operations.name: list_subcontracts
operations.description: Description: Federal prime subcontract award data.    Update Frequency: Updated weekly.    Update Check Field: last_modified_date (note that data is often reported late by prime awardees and we recommend periodically looking back over the prior year to fully sync new records).

operations.name: list_subgrants
operations.description: Description: Federal prime subgrant award data.    Update Frequency: Updated weekly.    Update Check Field: last_modified_date (note that data is often reported late by prime awardees and we recommend periodically looking back over the prior year to fully sync new records).

operations.name: list_contract_vehicles
operations.description: Description: Federal multi-award contract vehicles.    Update Frequency: Updated ad hoc as new awards are made.
